% Written by `lab paper blunder-hazard`; do not edit by hand.
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{lL}
\toprule
Feature & Description \\
\midrule
\texttt{material\_count} & The total material of both sides, counting a pawn as 1, a knight as 3, a bishop as 3.25, a rook as 5 and a queen as 9. \\
\texttt{material\_imbalance} & The mover's material minus the opponent's, on the same scale. \\
\texttt{phase\_piece\_count} & The number of knights, bishops, rooks and queens on the board, both sides together. \\
\texttt{in\_check} & Whether the mover is in check. \\
\texttt{legal\_moves} & The number of legal moves the mover has. \\
\texttt{legal\_captures} & The number of the mover's legal moves that are captures. \\
\texttt{legal\_checks} & The number of the mover's legal moves that give check. \\
\texttt{hanging\_own} & The number of the mover's pieces that are attacked by a less valuable piece, or attacked and not defended. \\
\texttt{hanging\_opponent} & The number of the opponent's pieces that are attacked by a less valuable piece, or attacked and not defended. \\
\texttt{passed\_pawns\_own} & The number of the mover's pawns with no enemy pawn ahead of them on their own or an adjacent file. \\
\texttt{passed\_pawns\_opponent} & The number of the opponent's pawns with no enemy pawn ahead of them on their own or an adjacent file. \\
\texttt{attackers\_near\_own\_king} & The number of attacks by the opponent on the squares adjacent to the mover's king. \\
\texttt{attackers\_near\_opponent\_king} & The number of attacks by the mover on the squares adjacent to the opponent's king. \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
